runtimeIncrement.scope: Existing /spaces and Kratos auth flows plus original /logout consumer; one shared deployed config/Viewer observation and admitted requestContext lifetime. Conditional homepage resolution on / and /home remains actual unsupported API refusal, not a usable front page. Member/settings/home/guest positive acceptance unfinished. Historical152-route census retained,0served pending actual E2E. Existing CrdSpaceRoutes mounts basic native About at canonical Space/Subspace paths, actual resolve remainder and arbitrary hierarchy; delivered child reader retained. Real unavailable/refused reads remain errors; no served acceptance. Existing /sign_up and /registration/* mount the real Kratos forms with authored terms/privacy. Browser signup verification is pending. rf2-create-dialogs (WP-RF2, spaces lead 2026-11-25): /home mounts the native dashboard under CrdLayoutWrapper with the native current user (NativeCurrentUserProvider around App); a top-level space's settings/* mounts CrdSpaceSettingsPage in CrdSpacePageLayout with the shell providers it needs; subspace settings stay not found until the subspace layout is mounted. c2-space-pages (WP-C2/C3, 021): the space routes mount at :spaceNameId/* in TopLevelRoutes as at 71f8 and CrdSpaceRoutes is the 71f8 route table again, read through the native route resolution and one SpacePage request (021 FR-003).
